record.bible_text: Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye the LORD<WH03050>. Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye the LORD<WH03068> from the heavens<WH08064>: praise<WH01984><WTH8761> him in the heights<WH04791>. <RF>Praise ye the LORD. Praise: Heb. Hallelujah, etc<Rf>
Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye him, all his angels<WH04397>: praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye him, all his hosts<WH06635>.
Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye him, sun<WH08121> and moon<WH03394>: praise<WH01984><WTH8761> him, all ye stars<WH03556> of light<WH0216>.
Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> him, ye heavens<WH08064> of heavens<WH08064>, and ye waters<WH04325> that <FI>be<Fi> above the heavens<WH08064>.
Let them praise<WH01984><WTH8762> the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>: for he commanded<WH06680><WTH8765>, and they were created<WH01254><WTH8738>.
He hath also stablished<WH05975><WTH8686> them for ever<WH05703> and ever<WH05769>: he hath made<WH05414><WTH8804> a decree<WH02706> which shall not pass<WH05674><WTH8799>.<CM>
Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> the LORD<WH03068> from the earth<WH0776>, ye dragons<WH08577>, and all deeps<WH08415>:
Fire<WH0784>, and hail<WH01259>; snow<WH07950>, and vapour<WH07008>; stormy<WH05591> wind<WH07307> fulfilling<WH06213><WTH8802> his word<WH01697>:
Mountains<WH02022>, and all hills<WH01389>; fruitful<WH06529> trees<WH06086>, and all cedars<WH0730>:
Beasts<WH02416>, and all cattle<WH0929>; creeping things<WH07431>, and flying<WH03671> fowl<WH06833>: <RF>flying...: Heb. birds of wing<Rf>
Kings<WH04428> of the earth<WH0776>, and all people<WH03816>; princes<WH08269>, and all judges<WH08199><WTH8802> of the earth<WH0776>:
Both young men<WH0970>, and maidens<WH01330>; old men<WH02205>, and children<WH05288>:

Let them praise<WH01984><WTH8762> the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>: for his name<WH08034> alone is excellent<WH07682><WTH8737>; his glory<WH01935> <FI>is<Fi> above the earth<WH0776> and heaven<WH08064>. <RF>excellent: Heb. exalted<Rf>

He also exalteth<WH07311><WTH8686> the horn<WH07161> of his people<WH05971>, the praise<WH08416> of all his saints<WH02623>; <FI>even<Fi> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, a people<WH05971> near<WH07138> unto him. Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye the LORD<WH03050>.<CM>
